DRACOLoader.js -- vendored
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js  (examples/jsm/loaders/DRACOLoader.js)
author: Mr.doob -- see LICENSE

Recorded at v4416.

*** THE DIRECTORY IS NAMED FOR A FORMAT AND HOLDS A LOADER FOR IT. *** Draco is Google's mesh
compression library. What is vendored here is three.js's LOADER for that format, one file,
DRACOLoader.js, whose licence names Mr.doob. Nothing of Google's Draco is in this directory: no
decoder wasm, no draco_decoder.js.

EVIDENCE:
  - LICENSE reads "Copyright (c) 2026 Mr.doob".
  - The single vendored file is DRACOLoader.js, three.js's loader by that name.
  - The only URL in the directory is https://mrdoob.github.io/draco.js/ -- a documentation page,
    not a repository, and this record does not treat it as one.

CONSEQUENCE, RECORDED BECAUSE IT MISLEADS: the author view attributes "draco" to Mr.doob. That is
correct about the bytes and wrong-sounding about the name, and no scan can tell the difference.
